_comment: Bogotá SITP / TransMilenio fares. Source: https://bogota.gov.co/mi-ciudad/movilidad/tarifa-transmilenio-transmicable-y-transmizonal-2026-bogota (valid from 2026-01-14). Edit this file when tariffs change; scripts/add_fares.py regenerates all fare files from it.

transfer._comment: Free transfers between troncal, zonal and TransMiCable within the window, only with a personalised TuLlave card. Concejo approved extending the window to 150 min (Aug 2026), not yet in force.

networks._comment: agency_id values from agency.txt in the official feed. Feeders (alimentadores) are free.

fare_media._comment: fare_media_type: 2 = physical transit card, 3 = cEMV contactless bank card. transfers=true means the free-transfer rule applies.
